name: Lemmy
_why_scale: Size pass (Nick): 1.10x Mario's in-game height (model height x the Bowser Jr. sizescale row x scale; Mario = 1.0, stock max DK 1.62). Was 1 (1.54x).
_why_model_blocks: Lemmy rides his circus ball while he runs (Nick): his model with the ball on bone 30 and his own banks that show it only in the run / jog / side-step cycles, lifting him onto it (scripts/lemmy_ride.py; rerun it after lemmy_pack.json's model changes). Without the ride: models/work/lemmy/pack/high.bin and low.bin, no 6-14.

bat._why: Magikoopa's scepter, orb orange: python scripts/bat_recolors.py lemmy

_why_balance: git-8a's balance pass (Nick): own stats; chemistry starts neutral (not the template's). Circus-ball Koopaling; youngest-feeling, plays with Larry and Jr.; beaten by Yoshi in SMW.
_why_strike_zone: python scripts/strike_zones.py --write: Bowser Jr.'s zone sits 67% of the way up its body in the batting stance (1.100 on 0.00..1.64); this body is 0.00..2.77, so 1.857 (the template's 1.100 would sit at 40%). World height = this x sizescale x scale
